title: Destroy the Dutch Defense!!
transcript: Are you a D4 player bored of the Dutch defense? Well, you're in for a treat because I'm going to show you the Manattan Gambit starting with Queen D3. We are threatening to win this pawn in one move, so black will defend it. The idea is that we're not going to sacrifice just one pawn, but two pawns to open up the king side and try to exploit this weak diagonal that goes to the king. In just a few moves, we can very quickly see how black is in trouble with all of these pieces pointing at the king side. And for example, if black now tries to kick us out with H6, we go Queen G6 check first. We kick the king out like this and then we win all of the black pieces and we hunt this king down on the queen side. And what if black decides to defend a pawn like this? Well, now we see an idea borrowed from the Dragon Sicilian and we go H4 and we're going to sacrifice the rook on H5 just to open up the king completely and hunt it down with the queen and get a completely dominating position out of the opening. And finally, if black decides to not take our bait, well, we're just going to get a very comfortable position where yes, we're down a pawn, but we have very active pieces and very good control of the center. If you would like to see an in-depth analysis of the Manattan Gambit, just let me know in the comments and I'll make a video about it. Leave a like and subscribe to the channel.
